d:
The Mavericks defeated the Nuggets, 120-101 tonight in Denver. Cooper Flagg finished with a team-high 24 points along with 12 assists and 6 rebounds for the Mavericks, while P.J. Washington tallied 14 points, 6 rebounds and 2 steals in the game. Jamal Murray recorded 20 points, 3 assists and 2 rebounds. The Mavericks improve their record to 11-7 with the win, while the Nuggets fall to 10-6 for the season.
